sources.headline: Ben Johnson takes another dig at Jared Goff's mobility
sources.description: When Bears coach Ben Johnson compared the mobility of quarterback Caleb Williams to the lack of mobility of Jared Goff in 2025, Johnson promptly explained he wasn't taking a shot at Goff.

sources.headline: Ben Johnson: Case Keenum's touchdown run was a "Mike Martz special" play call
sources.description: Bears head coach Ben Johnson has earned a reputation as an offensive innovator, but he didn't come up with the idea that led to one of his team's touchdowns in Monday's 27-7 win over the Eagles.

sources.headline: Ben Johnson called Jared Goff after latest mobility dig
sources.description: After the Bears beat the Eagles on Monday night with third-string quarterback Case Keenum, Chicago coach Ben Johnson made another cheeky remark about Lions quarterback Jared Goff's lack of mobility.
